Messages.Author: Talo...@nospam.hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
If sargon were to entice my prey, would he still have the edge when he
was done?

1-burn edge to burn preys 3 pool
2_action successful? sargon gets you the edge

T

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
In message <3c5c08d9.456954970@news>,
Talo...@nospam.hotmail.com mumbled something about:



Yes. Burning the Edge is part of the Enticement action -- at the end of
the action, you will no longer have the Edge.

Now, AFTER the action has been successfully performed (and therefore,
after the Edge has been burned), Sargon's special gives you the Edge.
